title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
summary: XSS injects script into pages users trust — encode output, CSP, and safe DOM APIs are layered defenses.
objectives: Explain Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in practical web-development terms
Recognize how Web Essentials connects to HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Apply safe habits and avoid common mistakes

content.md: No single header or filter stops every XSS variant — combine encoding, CSP, and safe frameworks.
